Apple Music on macOS Tahoe 26

The Music app in macOS Tahoe 26: opaque album content under a floating glass sidebar and a floating glass player bar.

Source
Apple Newsroom, June 9, 2025
Creator
Apple
Made
2025 (announced June 9, 2025)
Style
Liquid Glass (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Luminous, layered, premium
Evidence
Inspected the Apple Newsroom image Apple-WWDC25-macOS-Tahoe-26-Apple-Music-250609 (1960 × 1306, large_2x variant) in a scratchpad copy. A press render. Not stored.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple: in macOS Tahoe 26 “the Dock, sidebars, and toolbars have been refined, bringing greater focus to a user’s content”. Apple Newsroom.

The HIG: Liquid Glass “forms a distinct functional layer for controls and navigation elements — like tab bars and sidebars — that floats above the content layer”. Apple HIG: Materials.

Observed

  • A MacBook screen with a blue wave wallpaper, a transparent menu bar, and glass calendar and weather widgets on the desktop.
  • The Music window is opaque white with a large black “Home” title and rows of square album art with rounded corners.
  • The sidebar is a separate rounded panel inset inside the window, lighter than the content, with a faint pink and blue glow from the content beside it. Its selected item is a grey capsule.
  • A white player capsule floats over the lower row of album art, inset from the window edges. The art shows faintly through its edges.
  • The Dock is a long glass strip inset from the screen edge, with a lit upper rim.

Why it belongs

Here the glass is quiet. The style shows mainly in the floating, inset shapes and the content that runs under them, not in strong transparency.

Borrow

Float the media player as a capsule above the scrolling content instead of docking it as a full-width bar.

See also macOS Tahoe 26 Control Center.
